messages.subject: How to modifying myDiff25p?
parts:
I am working with cow and I have different chromosome IDs between my Bismark's .sam file and the annotated files dowloaded from UCSC in BED format. I want to modify the chromosome IDs in myDiff25p output generated by methylKit. The command I have used is:

myDiff25pMod <- replace(myDiff25pMod, grepl("GK000001.2", myDiff25pMod, perl=TRUE), "chr1")

but it didn't work (I am new in R). 

I have also tried to modify the .csv obtained with the write.csv function but when I tried to used it, it gives me this error:

> myDiff25pcsv <- read.csv("JPD584-02032SM_methDiff25p.csv")
> annotate.WithGenicParts(myDiff25pcsv,gene.obj)
Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  : 
  unable to find an inherited method for function ‘annotate.WithGenicParts’ for signature ‘"data.frame", "GRangesList"’

How can I modify the myDiff25p object in R?

Thanks!

Natalia
